run_collect_instrumentation_metrics: run the collect_instrumentation_metrics script on a JSONL file to analyze agent latency and throughput
run_collect_instrumentation_metrics_glob: run the collect_instrumentation_metrics script with a glob pattern to analyze multiple JSONL files
analyze_latency_breakdown: analyze per-task latency breakdown from instrumentation records and compute e2e delay and percentage contributions
analyze_network_bandwidth: analyze network bandwidth from ser_size_kb events using a sliding window and compute per-role statistics
analyze_throughput_breakdown: analyze per-role throughput events per second with a sliding window to identify agent bottlenecks
